content: nice graphics and animations! I still did not figure out the purpose of echo characters. Well I need some time to understand the logic to write a bot

Thanks! The echoes are what links the rounds together: everything a champion does in its round is played again in every later round. A champion that takes two crystals and destroys an enemy in round 1 scores those points again in rounds 2, 3 and 4, unless the opponent stops it.

And the input gives the full list of commands of every echo, so you know exactly where each one will walk and shoot. You can wait for an opponent's echo on its path, guard your own, or dodge the shots you know are coming.

So in each round you play against the past of both players, and what you play becomes the past of the next rounds.
